description: This module encrypts input using systemd‘s systemd-creds encrypt.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The credential name to embed in the encrypted credential data.

parameters.name: not_after
parameters.description: The time when the credential shall not be used anymore. Takes a timestamp specification in the format described in systemd.time(7).

parameters.name: pretty
parameters.description: Pretty print the output so that it may be pasted directly into a unit file. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: The timestamp to embed into the encrypted credential. Takes a timestamp specification in the format described in systemd.time(7).

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: A user name or numeric UID to encrypt the credential for. If set to the special string self it sets the user to the user of the calling process. Requires systemd 256 or later.

examples:
- name: Encrypt secret
  become: true
  community.general.systemd_creds_encrypt:
    name: db
    not_after: +48hr
    secret: access_token
  register: encrypted_secret

- name: Print the encrypted secret
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ encrypted_secret }}"

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: The Base64 encoded encrypted secret. Returned: always Sample: "WhQZht+JQJax1aZemmGLxmAAAA..."
